name: Matheus
source:
The first prince of the Fasan Kingdom. Due to a witch's curse, he's transformed into a lion.
Not only he's strong, but he also has a good head above his shoulders and is recognized as a brilliant strategist who can skillfully turn the tide of an overwhelmingly disadvantageous war situation.

He loves women and his motto is, "Don't reject those who come to you, don't pursue those who leave you". On the other hand, he hates men so much he doesn't let even his own brothers touch him.

[Translated from [url=http://www.otomate.jp/beast/flower_snow/chara/]Official site[/url]]
